messages:
sara: Incident bot failed to page for ~2 hours starting ~16:10 UTC. PagerFlow shows a stream of suppressed pages and then 502 errors from the incident API. Customers reported delayed alerts and one support ticket escalated.
ops-bot: @sara I see a surge of `detected_page` events followed by `post_page` failures in the last 2h. Dumping latest error: `POST /v1/incidents/page -> 502 Bad Gateway` from incident-api.
mike: I'm looking at the incident-api logs — upstream notify-proxy returned 502s due to timeout to pager-relay. No config changes deployed in the window.
ryan_oncall: I never got a page. I saw the slack thread but no pager. I was on-duty at 16:05-18:05.
linda_support: Customer-facing: we had an enterprise customer open a Sev1 saying they got no pager. They were routed to the support queue at 16:40.
eng-sre-bot: Alert: incidentbot.post_fail(rate=high) triggered. Rate window: 15m. First failure at 1765430600.
sara: Can we confirm whether this was a routing/filter/suppression policy or an upstream error? Need to know if automation suppressed correctly or accidentally blocked live pages.
mike: Quick triage: suppression policies look normal. The issue is a combination of notify-proxy timeouts and our incident bot treating 5xx as non-retriable due to a regression in 1.14.2 -> 1.15.0 (change in error handling). Rolling back notify client now.
ops-bot: Rollback started: deploy/incident-api v1.15.0 -> v1.14.2. ETA ~8m. Re-enabling manual page fanout during rollback: command `ops manual-page-fanout enable`.
ryan_oncall: Manual pages: done. Sent manual page to primary oncall, confirmed ACK from oncall device. :thumbsup:
sara: Re-run the failed page queue after rollback? We need to confirm oncall receives retries.
mike: Replayed queued pages at 1765432230. Delivery logs show successful POST and PAGER_ACK for 98% of replayed items. Two timed out to a third-party SMS gateway — support escalated those customers.
linda_support: Noted two customers with missed SMS pages; support notified them and created followups.
eng-sre-bot: Post-rollback checks: incident-api error-rate back to baseline, no suppression spikes. Setting incident severity to MEDIUM and starting a follow-up postmortem thread.
sara: Thanks all. Action items: 1) postmortem draft (eng + ops) 2) add retry on 5xx in incidentbot client 3) run chaos test for notify-proxy timeouts. Assigning owners in the postmortem doc. 
ops-bot: Follow-up: assigned owners in tracker -> mike (notify client fix), ryan_oncall (oncall delivery playbook), linda_support (customer comms).
mike: Will open PR for client retry behavior and add integration test for 502 path.
ryan_oncall: I'll update the oncall runbook with manual fanout steps and confirm pager contact verification flow.
sara: Temporary mitigation note: manual fanout command and replay queue are available as standard ops steps — remind teams after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
